description: Sends a booking request as the booking page does, once the traveller has seen the price and accepted the terms of sale (https://www.cote-privee.com/terms): one service (the fields of quote, with date, time and pickup), several (items) or a plan of find_trips (trip, startDate), and the traveller's details. Nothing is charged: the traveller gets the request by e-mail, and the driver confirms it by e-mail and says how to pay the full price, or declines it (next says it for this request; payment: "in full when the driver confirms"). dry_run checks and prices without sending; the same request within a day, or the same requestId, answers the same reference. Only valid requests count against the limits; a refusal names each argument to fix and what is allowed (retryAfter after a limit).

accept_terms.description: true only once the traveller has accepted the terms of sale.

dropoff.description: A ride: where the car leaves the guests (a hotel).

items.description: Several services (at most 6), each with the fields above.

lang.description: ar: Arabic notes, data in English.

pickup.description: Pickup address (a hotel, a street) at the start of a ride or of the day.

name: request_booking
title: Send a booking request
